study_design: Population-based case-control study following mass prostate cancer screening
reason: The case-control study evaluates prostate cancer diagnosed through mass screening without analyzing an aggressive disease subtype. The exact total analytic sample is not directly stated in the abstract and is not inferred from the 1:10 matching ratio.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was no significant difference in P trend for any dairy food.
estimate_classifications.reason: The dairy result concerns prostate cancer generally; no aggressive endpoint is defined.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In addition, men who consumed soybean products more than once per day had a multivariate OR of 0.29 (95% CI, 0.11-0.79) compared with men who consumed soybean products less than once per week.
estimate_classifications.reason: The soybean-product estimate is for prostate cancer generally, not an aggressive subtype.
